name: doit
description: Daily LeetCode + system design prep tracker

scripts.package: vite build && electron-packager . DOIT --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --ignore='^/(src|release|build|electron-dist|index.html|vite.config.js|node_modules)($|/)' && npx @electron/fuses write --app release/DOIT-darwin-arm64/DOIT.app RunAsNode=off && codesign --force --deep -s - release/DOIT-darwin-arm64/DOIT.app
scripts.install-app: npm run package && rm -rf /Applications/DOIT.app && cp -R release/DOIT-darwin-arm64/DOIT.app /Applications/
